notes: Mesh names and topology are discovered automatically; no hand-written exhaustive pair list.
Excluded pairs require two exact geom names and a reason. Never suppress a pair just because the baseline already overlaps.
Pair overrides may reduce clearance to zero for an intentional touch, but may not allow penetration; changes require a reason.
Quick checks are conservative bounding-box screening only. Candidate checks use mesh distances. Only a complete trajectory result with status passed is exportable.
The visible floor is not included in this self-collision group. Scene objects and real-world obstacles require separate collision geometry.
Model bounds, convex hulls, numerical tolerances and actual robot calibration limit the result. No physical collision response is enabled by this file.
